findings.title: Audit increment — no code changes
findings.description: Increment 0159 is an audit/evaluation deliverable. No .astro/.tsx source files were modified. Outputs are reports/ and metrics JSON. Code review and grill findings therefore apply to the audit reports themselves.
evidence: git diff shows no .astro/.tsx/.ts source modifications during this increment
spec.md explicitly states: '本 increment 是审计/评估类工作——产出可执行报告与建议文档,而不是直接修改组件代码'
findings.recommendation: Close as audit deliverable. Future increments 0160+ will implement the recommended fixes.

findings.title: Audit reports are complete and actionable
findings.description: ui-ux-audit-report.md contains 4 findings (raw form elements, dark mode coverage, hardcoded px, admin islands size) with file/line evidence, severity ratings, and P0/P1/P2 prioritized recommendations. ui-baseline-metrics.json contains all required fields (totalPages, totalViolations, rawButtonCount, rawInputCount, hardcodedPxCount, missingDarkModeCount, cssVariableViolations).
evidence: reports/ui-ux-audit-report.md: 146 lines, 4 numbered findings, 6 prioritized recommendations
reports/ui-baseline-metrics.json: validates against spec AC-0159-US3-01 schema
Baseline metrics: 58 pages, 25 islands, 278 total violations, 24% dark mode coverage
findings.recommendation: Reports satisfy AC-0159-US1-01..05, AC-0159-US2-01..04, AC-0159-US3-01..02. No gaps detected.

findings.title: Baseline metrics ready for follow-up increments
findings.description: AC-0159-US3-02 requires baseline data to be used as 'before' comparison for increment 0160+. The metrics JSON is structured to support delta computation: totalViolations, rawButtonCount, hardcodedPxCount, darkModeCoverage.percentage are all numeric and can be diffed against post-refactor measurements.
evidence: ui-baseline-metrics.json: all required AC-0159-US1 and US3-01 fields present
adminIslandsOver300 array: 8 islands with line counts and priority ratings
findings.recommendation: Increment 0160+ should git-track ui-baseline-metrics.json for delta measurement.

notes: Audit increment closed as deliverable. All 9 tasks complete, all 11 ACs satisfied, both required reports present and well-structured. No blockers.
